Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is looking for a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to design, scale, and secure the identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms that power our global, remote-first workforce. You will set the technical direction for how employees and devices connect to Carrot systems, while staying hands-on in the tooling, automation, and complex problem-solving that make IT reliable at scale.

This role sits at the center of IT engineering. You will lead larger initiatives from design through rollout, partner closely with Information Security on zero-trust and compliance priorities, and raise the bar for the rest of the team through standards, documentation, and mentorship. If you want broad technical ownership, influence over the IT roadmap, and the chance to build systems that grow with a high-growth healthcare company, this role was built for that.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Architect and own Carrot's identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms, including Okta, JAMF, Intune, and Google Workspace, with a focus on security, reliability, and user experience
  • Lead design and rollout of larger IT initiatives, such as zero-trust access models, device compliance frameworks, and global endpoint standards
  • Build and maintain automation and infrastructure as code that manage configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows at scale
  • Partner with Information Security to design controls, drive vulnerability management, and keep Carrot audit-ready for SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security reviews
  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point, leading incident response and root cause analysis for complex or high-impact issues
  • Define engineering standards, runbooks, and documentation, and mentor IT teammates to grow their technical depth
  • Evaluate vendors and tools, build business cases, and make clear recommendations on build versus buy tradeoffs
  • Design environments that support global care and operations teams, including secure and efficient remote computing setups
  • Contribute to the IT roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and progress to technical and business stakeholders

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a clear, documented architecture and standards for identity, endpoint, and SaaS management that the team can build on
  • Delivered at least one major platform initiative, such as a zero-trust access model or endpoint modernization, with measurable gains in security posture and employee experience
  • Reduced manual IT work through automation and infrastructure as code, with a measurable drop in recurring ticket volume
  • Strengthened audit readiness, contributing to clean results on security and compliance reviews
  • Raised the technical capability of the team through mentorship, documentation, and shared standards
  • Built trusted partnerships with Information Security, People, Engineering, and Finance

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • 6+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint engineering, or infrastructure roles, including ownership of production platforms
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with identity and access platforms such as Okta, including SSO, SCIM, lifecycle automation, and conditional access
  • Expert-level experience managing Mac and Windows fleets with JAMF and Intune, including packaging, deployment, security policy, and compliance enforcement
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (for example Python, Bash, or PowerShell), with experience using APIs and source-controlled configuration
  • Experience designing and implementing security controls, such as encryption, vulnerability management, and zero-trust principles, in partnership with Security teams
  • A track record of leading cross-functional technical projects from design through rollout without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tradeoffs for executive and non-technical audiences

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in healthcare, health tech, or another regulated environment (for example, HIPAA or SOC 2)
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices applied to endpoint or SaaS configuration
  • Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and modern cloud networking concepts
  • Experience designing remote computing environments for call center or clinical operations teams, such as VDI or managed browser models
  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows or tooling to improve IT operations
  • Relevant certifications (for example JAMF Certified Expert, Okta Certified Professional, or Microsoft Endpoint Administrator)

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Every Carrot employee depends on technology that is secure, reliable, and easy to use, whether they are supporting members through deeply personal care journeys or partnering with global employers. This role sets the technical foundation that makes that possible.

As Carrot continues to scale across geographies and functions, the architecture and standards you establish will protect member trust, strengthen our security posture, and give the business the speed and confidence to keep growing.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation💰

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package.

  • Base Salary Range: $150,000 – $175,000 (primary range).
  • Geo-Tier Adjustment: Up to $190,000 for highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

title: macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer to engineer, automate and continuously improve the services that support our global Apple device estate. This role is focused on delivering a secure, reliable and consistent macOS experience at scale through Jamf Pro, reusable code, APIs and modern engineering practices. 
 
You will replace repetitive administration and one-off scripts with maintainable automation for device enrolment, configuration, application delivery, patching, compliance and lifecycle management. Working across Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager, identity, security, asset and service-management platforms, you will build integrations and workflows that make Apple device services easier to operate, measure and support. 
 

Engineering mindset 
Automation is the product, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who sees a manual Jamf task, fragile policy or recurring Mac support issue and asks, “How can we make this reliable, reusable and self-service?” 

You should be comfortable working from Apple and Jamf documentation, investigating unfamiliar behaviours and translating operational requirements into production-quality automation. Your solutions account for failure, test changes before release, scale to an enterprise environment, provide useful telemetry and favour reusable frameworks over isolated scripts. You take ownership from design through operation, document your work and balance long-term platform improvements with immediate business needs. 
 
What success looks like 
You will measurably reduce manual effort, deployment lead time and configuration drift across the macOS estate. Enrollment, configuration, software delivery, patching, security compliance and device lifecycle processes will become increasingly automated, observable, auditable and recoverable. 
 
Over time, you will establish a scalable Apple endpoint automation model based on Jamf Pro, APIs, version-controlled code, release pipelines and shared engineering standards rather than manual platform administration. 


What you'll do

macOS Platform & Jamf Automation 

  • Design and maintain automation for macOS enrolment, provisioning, configuration, application delivery, updates and device retirement using Jamf Pro. 

  • Build reusable scripts, tools and workflows using shell scripting, Python, Jamf APIs and other appropriate technologies. 

  • Administer and automate Jamf policies, configuration profiles, Jamf Blueprints, Jamf compliance, extension attributes, smart groups, packages and lifecycle workflows. 

  • Integrate Jamf Pro and Apple Business Manager with identity, security, asset, infrastructure and service-management platforms. 

  • Apply Git, CI/CD, automated testing and configuration-as-code practices so Apple platform changes are controlled, repeatable and auditable. 

    • Security, Compliance & Observability 

  • Translate macOS security and compliance requirements into Jamf configuration profiles, automated controls and measurable outcomes. 

  • Automate macOS and third-party application patching, vulnerability remediation and exception handling. 

  • Build guardrails for FileVault, endpoint protection, authentication, privacy controls and device compliance. 

  • Create inventory, telemetry, dashboards and alerting that provide actionable visibility into automation performance, Mac health and risk. 

  • Partner with Security teams to automate evidence collection, audit reporting and remediation workflows for the Apple estate. 

    • Engineering, Lifecycle & Support 

  • Define the macOS and Jamf automation architecture, engineering standards and roadmap for a global Apple device service. 

  • Engineer automated packaging, deployment, update and rollback pipelines for macOS applications. 

  • Evaluate Jamf, Apple and related ecosystem capabilities, APIs and emerging technologies to simplify or extend the service. 

  • Troubleshoot complex failures across macOS, Jamf, identity, networking, security and application-delivery services. 

  • Convert recurring Mac incidents and support escalations into automated detection, remediation or prevention. 

  • Document designs, code, operating procedures and support models, and enable support teams to use them effectively. 

    •  
     

    What you'll need

  • Jamf 300 certification. 

  • 4+ years of experience engineering and automating macOS services in a modern enterprise environment. 

  • Deep hands-on expertise with Jamf Pro, including policies, profiles, smart groups, extension attributes, inventory, application deployment and API-based administration. 

  • Strong knowledge of macOS management, Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, declarative device management and Apple security controls. 

  • Ability to build production-quality automation using shell scripting, Python, REST APIs and structured data formats, supported by Git, CI/CD, testing, secrets management, Jamf webhooks and code review. 

  • Experience automating macOS application packaging, deployment, patching and vulnerability remediation; a bachelor’s degree in IT or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. 

    •  

    Additional experience that would be valuable: 

  • Experience with identity integrations, Platform SSO, certificate services, zero-touch deployment and device trust. 

  • Knowledge of Installomator, swiftDialog, Nudge, or similar community and enterprise macOS automation tooling. 

  • Experience integrating Jamf with ServiceNow, asset-management, security, observability or data platforms. 

  • Cloud services, serverless functions, SQL or reporting technologies used to host integrations and analyse endpoint data. 

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, Linux or mobile device management in a broader endpoint environment. 

    •  
     

     


     

    What we offer

    A competitive compensation package, of course.  

    Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 

    Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.  

    Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

    Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 

    Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.  

    Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 

    Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. 

    Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! 

    Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. 


    Meet your team

    We’re Employee IT. We’re on a mission to deliver a seamless user experience for TomTom'ers across. Whether we're creating solutions to enable collaboration, increase productivity or help people communicate, your work will ensure TomTom'ers are equipped to create the first real-time map. In our team, you’ll help design, develop, deliver, operate and support solutions through a defined set of services, so that we can continue to bring people closer to the world around them.


    At TomTom...

    You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

    Work with a team of 3,300+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.


    After you apply

    Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs.


    TomTom is an equal opportunity employer

    TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

title: Advance Pricing Analytics Actuary
description:
About Insify

We are a start-up offering an end-to-end digital insurance platform focussing solely on European entrepreneurs and SMEs. We offer the best insurance to our customers thanks to our focus on user experience, our leading underwriting services, and our expertise in data. In short, we’ve made getting insured quick, transparent and simple.

We know how to innovate - our team of seasoned entrepreneurs has built a host of successful businesses in fintech and e-commerce (HelloFresh, Bloomon and SumUp to name a few!).We’ve already raised over €25M in funding from leading investors (Accel Ventures, Frontline Ventures, Visionaries Club, Nico Rosberg, etc.), who love what we do and see the potential for a revolution in digital insurance.

We started our journey in the Netherlands and with our mission to make business insurance fast, simple and fair we have been able to have a significant impact on that market. Since last year we also serve customers in France and Germany, and are rapidly expanding across the rest of Europe!

How we work

At Insify, we’re building more than just an insurance company—we’re creating a culture that’s bold, caring, and built to make a real difference. Everything we do is driven by our core values: grit, impact, care, and entrepreneurship.

We show up with passion and perseverance. We solve real problems and put people first—especially our customers. And we’re always looking for smarter, faster, more human ways to do things.

That’s also why we’ve chosen a pro-office approach. We believe that working together, face to face, sparks creativity, builds stronger teams, and helps us learn faster—especially for new joiners. From spontaneous brainstorms to shared lunches, being in the same space makes the magic happen.

Joining Insify means being part of a team that truly backs each other and the entrepreneurs we serve. If you’re ready to grow, innovate, and help reshape the insurance industry from the inside out—we’d love to meet you.

Insurance Team

We’re the team making insurance work for everyone and everything. At Insify, our Insurance crew is all about making sure the right coverages are available, affordable, and actually make sense for today’s entrepreneurs. We’re the bridge between customer needs and carrier capabilities—constantly exploring, negotiating, and building better insurance solutions.

From partnering with top carriers to developing our own products, we ensure our platform delivers complete, seamless coverage. Whether it’s a roofer in Rotterdam or a freelance designer in Berlin, we’re here to make sure no one’s left out. Our team includes insurance pros, actuaries, and product ops experts working hand-in-hand with product, legal, and compliance to reshape insurance from the inside out.

About the Role
 
This is your chance to work in a dynamic company where innovation and precision go hand in hand to disrupt the insurance industry. You'll be part of our Insurance team, as lead to ensure the scalability and sustainability of our portfolio optimizing both the bottom and top lines.
 
We are a data-driven company and we don’t lose time on tasks with little to no value therefore, on top of modeling the risk, price elasticity, customer lifetime value, and other key business drivers and trends, you will also be supporting the full End-to-end automation, set up of proper data flows, tooling and overall pricing platform solution.

What you will be doing
  • Pricing and Underwriting: Develop and refine pricing models, ensuring accurate underwriting and profitability while optimizing for growth.
  • Dig for and leverage internal and external data to develop predictive models that enhance pricing strategies and improve portfolio performance.
  • Evaluate and propose new ideas and collaborate with the team to develop and push in production innovative solutions (pricing elasticity and optimisation, behaviour and fraud scoring, exposure-based dynamic pricing…), 
  • Work with internal stakeholders to integrate actuarial insights into product, tech, regulatory compliance, and overall company strategy.
  • Follow market trends to recommend adjustments to pricing and products.
  • Lead relationships with risk carriers to drive impactful results.
  • Be part, with the pricing team, of the development of our End-to-end, fully automated, pricing and analytics platform leveraging on data and innovative in-house proprietary solutions to scale in a sustainable and efficient way and always stay ahead of competition.

    • What you'll need
  • Actuarial diploma (or equivalent).
  • 2–3+ years of experience in pricing and underwriting within Property & Casualty insurance or Life Insurance.
  • Strong data analytics skills and a passion for leveraging data to drive innovation.
  • A global mindset with exposure to developed insurance markets (e.g., UK, Germany, France) with a desire to disrupt a slow-moving industry.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a desire to build new things.
  • Strong interpersonal skills—smooth communication and collaboration are key!

title: Database Support Engineer (Japanese Speaking)
description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced, fluent Japanese speaking Database Support Engineer to join our Support Team and help developers unblock complex issues, build more reliably, and get the most out of the Supabase platform. You’ll work closely with customers and engineering, helping us improve product quality and developer experience based on real-world usage.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What You’ll Be Responsible for

In this role, you’ll:

  • Investigate and resolve advanced customer issues across Postgres, Auth, RLS, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions, and client libraries.

  • Provide consultative, proactive advice to optimize workloads, avoid common pitfalls, and tailored advice to our most advanced users.

  • Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, propose workarounds, and escalate to engineering with solid repro steps.

  • Ask smart, targeted questions that turn incomplete reports into actionable cases.

  • Communicate clearly and empathetically with customer users of all levels—especially during high-impact or time-sensitive situations.

  • Spot patterns across tickets and recommend improvements to docs, tooling, and the product itself.

  • Mentor junior team members and help raise the overall bar for support quality.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • You have 6+ years in technical support, backend engineering, SRE, or similar.

  • You know PostgreSQL deeply—autovacuum behavior, WAL growth, long-running transactions, table bloat, and other internals.

  • You’re strong in high-performance SQL and query optimization.

  • You’re comfortable troubleshooting complex setups, including multi-tenant schema patterns.

  • You can debug edge functions and understand distributed system behavior when failures get tricky.

  • You’ve handled data migration issues (pg_dump/restore, schema drift, failed migrations) and know how to recover safely.

  • You have hands-on experience with cloud hosting providers like AWS.

  • You’re comfortable in terminal and Linux environments.

  • You thrive in high-volume situations and can form/test assumptions quickly.

Additional Requirements

  • Must be a fluent bilingual Japanese/English Speaker

  • Must have experience support complex technical products in Japanese with native speakers

  • Ideally located in Japan, but location is flexible as long as you can work during Japan business hours.

データベースサポートエンジニア

Supabaseについて
Supabaseは、開発者が開発者のために作ったPostgres開発プラットフォームです。データベース、認証、ストレージ、Edge Functions、リアルタイム機能、ベクトル検索を含む、完全なバックエンドソリューションを提供しています。すべてのサービスは緊密に統合されており、成長に対応できるよう設計されています。

職務内容について
経験豊富な日本語で対応可能なデータベースサポートエンジニアを募集し、サポートチームに参加していただきます。開発者の複雑な課題解決を支援し、より信頼性の高い開発を実現し、Supabaseプラットフォームを最大限に活用していただけるようサポートします。お客様やグローバルのエンジニアリングチームと密接に連携し、実際の利用状況に基づいて製品品質や開発者体験の向上に貢献していただきます。

このポジションは、非同期かつスピード感のある環境で力を発揮でき、数百万人規模で利用される開発者ツールの構築にやりがいを感じる方に最適です。

主な業務内容
このポジションでは、以下の業務を担当していただきます。

  • Postgres、認証、RLS、ストレージ、リアルタイム機能、Edge Functions、クライアントライブラリにまたがる高度な顧客課題の調査・解決

  • ワークロードの最適化やよくある落とし穴の回避に向けたコンサルティング的かつ積極的なアドバイスの提供、および最も高度なユーザーへの個別対応

  • バグの再現、根本原因の特定、回避策の提案、および確実な再現手順を伴うエンジニアリングチームへのエスカレーション

  • 不完全な報告内容を対応可能な案件に変えるための、的確で的を絞った質問

  • あらゆるレベルの顧客ユーザーとの明確かつ思いやりのあるコミュニケーション(特に影響度が高い、または緊急性の高い状況において)

  • チケット全体からパターンを見出し、ドキュメント、ツール、製品自体の改善を提案

  • ジュニアメンバーの育成、サポート品質全体の向上への貢献

以下に当てはまる方はこのポジションに向いています

  • テクニカルサポート、バックエンドエンジニアリング、SRE、または類似職種で6年以上の経験がある方

  • PostgreSQLに関する深い知識をお持ちの方(autovacuumの挙動、WALの増加、長時間実行トランザクション、テーブルの肥大化などの内部構造を含む)

  • 高パフォーマンスなSQLおよびクエリ最適化に強みをお持ちの方

  • マルチテナントのスキーマパターンを含む、複雑な構成のトラブルシューティングに抵抗がない方

  • Edge Functionsのデバッグができ、障害が複雑化した際の分散システムの挙動を理解できる方

  • データ移行に関する問題(pg_dump/restore、スキーマの差異、移行失敗など)に対応した経験があり、安全な復旧方法を理解している方

  • AWSなどのクラウドホスティングプロバイダーでの実務経験がある方

  • ターミナルおよびLinux環境に抵抗なく対応できる方

  • 業務量の多い状況でも力を発揮でき、素早く仮説を立てて検証できる方

追加要件

  • 日本語・英語のバイリンガルであること

  • 日本語の顧客を対象に、技術製品のサポートを行った経験があること

  • 日本在住が望ましいですが、日本の勤務時間帯に対応できれば勤務地は柔軟に対応可能です

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Engineer Software Defined Vehicle Simulation and Development
description:
NIKI is looking for graduates of Technical University Departments/Schools of Sciences/Engineers, or similar disciplines to support and develop complex system simulation processes of software-defined vehicles.

Become a member of NIKI Digital Engineering!

If you have completed your studies or doctorate and are looking for new challenges, interdisciplinary and diverse teams, and projects, send us your resume.

Our strategy is to transfer the know-how into practice. TWT is our trusted long-term partner, sharing and supporting our vision. Through close, daily collaboration, we design and deliver innovative solutions for clients and partners across the energy, health, and automotive industries. Combining interdisciplinary expertise in IT, digital engineering, and consulting, we turn ideas into impactful results that reflect our shared vision for progress.

What to expect

  • Develop and optimize process and simulation methods for complex vehicle development in collaboration with international industry partners and research organizations.
  • Continuously monitor industry trends and advances in simulation technology to improve NIKI's services and drive innovation.
  • Coordinate our interdisciplinary projects in close cooperation with our customers.

Task Description

  • Modeling and simulation of complex systems and software functions. Focus on areas such as driving dynamics and autonomous driving.
  • Active cooperation with our customers. Programming of functions and algorithms for modern vehicle functions. Accompanying the process from the first idea to delivery.
  • Forward-looking development processes. Functional and vehicle development using the latest methods and tools, such as graphic modeling languages.
  • Empowering and coaching our clients.
  • Protection of software functions. Efficient implementation of technical security measures and criticality analysis of software functions.
  • Creation of test concepts. Development of automated test cases according to existing customer requirements. Test execution on the test bench or in road tests hedging concepts.
  • Development of new concepts for safeguarding networked systems (MIL/SIL/HIL) and also autonomous driving functions.
  • Development, commissioning, and testing of complex, multifunctional test benches.
  • Collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality technical solutions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Knowledge of modeling and numerical simulation of mechanical systems.
  • Familiarization with the application of simulation or design software tools.
  • Good knowledge of at least one of the languages: Python, Matlab or Java.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Spirit of innovation, initiative, and enjoyment of learning and tinkering.
  • Excellent command of English and technical terminology.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the automotive industry, with a focus on vehicle development and simulation.
  • Initial knowledge of semi-formal modeling languages such as UML, SysML or Matlab/Simulink or initial experience in handling measurement technology or test benches, such as Vector, dSPACE, ETAS, or initial experience with control units and software in the embedded area.
  • Interest in interdisciplinary collaborations.
  • Good command of the German language.

What we offer

  • Structured learning on the job, professional feedback, and a mentor open to all your questions.
  • Innovative, highly technically demanding industry and research projects, interdisciplinary teams, and highly qualified colleagues.
  • Open doors, and the chance to take over responsibility quickly - participate, shape, and leave your fingerprint.
  • Discover new talents and shape your career path: Become a specialist, project manager, or manager.
  • Simultaneous, collaborative work using modern digital platforms.
  • Workplace flexibility.
  • Flexible working hours thanks to our attractive flextime model - only compatible projects.
  • Enjoy working with great colleagues in your day-to-day work.

Are you intrigued to find out more about this position? Then apply for a job with us!

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Legal Engineering Counsel
description:
We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse

Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.

To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital.

What weâre looking for

Stedi is hiring a Legal Engineering Counsel to build how our legal work gets done, and to own a large share of it. Every new customer, payer connection, and partnership runs through a contract, and the volume grows every month. Youâll design the systems that handle it (playbooks, review workflows, automation, and AI tooling) and run them on live deals with counterparties ranging from fast-moving healthtech startups to national payers.

This role pairs legal practice with technical skill. You bring strong legal training and a feel for how commercial deals work, and youâve used AI and other technology to make legal work faster and more consistent. What you learn on live deals shapes the systems, and better systems make the next deal faster.

Youâll join a small, effective Legal team with a broad mandate. We keep up with a fast-growing, highly regulated business by investing in good systems and tools, and this role sits at the center of that investment. Healthcare experience is not required â we value strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn a new industry quickly. If you have the talent and drive to help build a world-class legal function alongside Stediâs experienced legal counsel mentors at a rapidly scaling tech company, we want to talk.

What youâll do

  • Build and own the systems behind Stediâs contracting, including playbooks, clause libraries, templates, intake and approval workflows, and AI-assisted first-pass review.

  • Break recurring legal work into repeatable steps with clear inputs, decision points, and escalation paths, then decide what to automate, what to standardize, and what needs a lawyer.

  • Turn our legal counselâs nuanced advice, negotiation positions, and fallbacks into structured guidance that people and AI tools can apply consistently.

  • Test and measure what you build. Check outputs against real deals, track where the tools fall short, and iterate until they hold up.

  • Draft and negotiate contracts yourself using those systems â including customer agreements, BAAs, NDAs, payer trading partner agreements â from first redline through signature.

  • Structure our contract data so the team (and our tools) can answer questions about our agreements in minutes.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management. Build self-serve paths for routine agreements and field the questions that still need a person.

  • Take on new areas based on interest and business need as Stedi and the Legal team grow.

Who you are

  • Youâre bar-admitted and want to practice law while building the systems that support it.

  • BigLaw or in-house experience, ideally on transactional work, is a strong plus.

  • Youâve built with technology, whether thatâs AI workflows, prompts and evaluations, automations, scripts, or no-code tools, and you can show what you made.

  • Youâre comfortable working with structured data and technical tools, and you pick up new ones quickly. Coding experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • You can explain complex issues in plain language, write clearly, and communicate confidently with executives, lawyers, procurement staff, engineers, and everyone in between.

  • Youâre comfortable with high-volume work, ambiguity, and shifting priorities, and you maintain high quality through effective habits.

  • You move fast, operate with precision, and follow through until the job is done. You thrive in an environment where clarity, accountability, and urgency matter. Youâre hungry to learn, seek out feedback, and put it to work.

Weâve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team. Please note:

  • All official communication about roles at Stedi will only come from an @stedi.com email address, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com.

  • If youâre unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to contact us directly at careers@stedi.com.

We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi.

At Stedi, we're looking for people who are deeply curious and aligned to our ways of working. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.

This is a strong entry point into tech sales for someone who wants to learn and refine the fundamentals of prospecting, discovery, and pipeline generation inside an enterprise software motion. You'll work directly with Account Executives but will also be responsible for prospecting into your own patch. We ask that all of our ADRs have a remote environment that is conducive to consistent weekly motions and to be able to travel 4-6 times per year, usually a week or less at a time.

What you will do:

As an ADR I, you'll run long-term outbound and timely inbound prospecting motions to generate qualified pipeline for our sales team. Working emails, sales cadences, social outreach and most importantly calls to get in front of the right people at the right accounts at the right time. This role exists because a sustainable pipeline is built through persistence, consistency, a growth mindset and an ability to diagnose challenges and bring solutions within your own prospecting motion.

  • Generate qualified pipeline by running outbound prospecting across email, phone, event outreach and attendance and LinkedIn into target accounts.

  • Qualify inbound interest through ADR-led scheduled calls and convert into booked meetings for Account Executives.

  • Research accounts, personas and signals to tailor and leverage AI for high touch low impact motions.

  • Partner with Account Executives to understand what constitutes a quality meeting, contact and account, and adjust your approach based on feedback.

  • Exhibit excellent operational hygiene by tracking activity and pipeline health in Salesforce and other sales tools to monitor your own inputs and performance.

  • Learn Camunda's product and value propositions and the process orchestration space well enough to have credible, useful conversations with prospects in specific verticals.

What you bring:

  • Fluency in German

  • Some experience with outbound prospecting or customer-facing communication is preferred. This doesn't have to be in sales. Internships, retail, hospitality, or customer support all count if you know how to build rapport with people, manage expectations and handle rejection.

  • Comfort with strict time management and prioritization of requests. You'll be conducting a lot of calls and emails, and you're motivated by the math of it. You will also be given regular enablement and will be responsible for monitoring multiple sources of leads.

  • Curiosity about technology and a willingness to learn a technical product. You don't need an engineering background, but you need to be genuinely interested in understanding what Camunda does and why it matters to the people you're calling. You share successes.

  • Resilience and self-awareness. You know how to keep going without getting discouraged, and you can tell the difference between a bad day and a bad approach.

  • Coachability. You take feedback from your manager and AEs seriously and change your approach in a timely and meaningful way based on it.

  • Cross-functional relationships. You have a curiosity as to how things work and which individuals you can support and thus that can support you. You ask questions and challenge the status quo if you’ve experienced a better solution.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

title: Customer Success Engineer
description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

We're hiring a Customer Success Engineer to join the Technical Solutions team, the small team that keeps Omnea working for our customers every day. This role is based in London. This is a customer-facing role with a technical problem-solving heart: when an integration breaks, a workflow misbehaves, or a customer needs Omnea to do something it doesn't do yet, you help find the root cause and the right solution. We resolve around 95% of what comes to us ourselves, from straightforward fixes to changes in production code and small feature requests. You'll be trusted to work out what's really wrong and see it through, drawing on the team's support when you need it.

You'll go deep on the product and broad on the problems: an integration misbehaving with a customer's ERP in the morning, a feature a customer has been asking for after lunch, and helping a colleague through a tough customer conversation by the end of the day. You'll be a trusted voice customers can turn to, joining their calls, providing clear answers and working closely with the Account Management team to set them up for long-term success with Omnea. AI helps us investigate faster, tracing logs, drafting hypotheses and suggesting fixes, but people own the outcome. You'll use your judgment, and the team's expertise where needed, to make sure solutions are safe for a live enterprise environment, address the root cause and surface patterns Product needs to hear about.

The CSE team sits between Customer, Product and Engineering. It's a small, close-knit team with a lot of autonomy, and the scope of the role grows as Omnea does. There is room to lean into your strengths, whether that's guiding customers towards solutions or bringing their feedback into the product, while building your technical skills. You'll develop deep knowledge of Omnea, and your work will be felt by customers every day.

What You'll Do

  • Investigate the hard problems. One issue might be an integration failing with a customer's ERP, the next a workflow that isn't doing what anyone expected, the next a cross-system bug nobody else has cracked. You'll use AI to speed up the first pass, then confirm the cause and get it fixed.

  • Make solutions happen. Own issues through to resolution, whether that means guiding a customer through a solution, improving a workflow or working on a code change. You'll have opportunities to fix bugs and build small customer-requested features in the codebase, with support from the team as you grow. Depending on your strengths, you might lean further into customer guidance or into shaping and improving the product.

  • Back up our Implementation and Customer teams. When a colleague hits a tricky configuration, an edge case or a question they can't answer, they come to you. You'll help them think it through, step into live implementations when they get technical, and make sure the customer gets the right answer.

  • Stay close to customers. You'll have ongoing calls with some customers, join QBRs and escalation calls, get brought in on specialist projects, and represent the Technical Solutions Team when customers move from implementation to ongoing support.

  • Bring the customer's voice into Product. You'll hear what customers struggle with before anyone else does. Spot the patterns across the issues you resolve and turn them into clear, well-argued input for Product, so the same problem doesn't need solving twice.

  • Make it scale. As we grow, we can't just add people. You'll build the tooling, automation, playbooks and docs that help customers solve more on their own and let the team handle more without slowing down.

About You

  • You have at least 3 years of relevant experience, for example in technical support engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, software development or another technical, customer-facing role.

  • You're curious. You want to know how things work and why they broke, and every problem is a chance to learn something.

  • You solve problems analytically. You enjoy messy, ambiguous issues, and you don't stop at the symptom when you can find the root cause.

  • You're comfortable switching context. A bug fix, a customer call and a colleague's question can all land in the same hour, and you can move between them without losing the thread.

  • You want variety. You'd rather handle ten different problems than one big project.

  • You take ownership. You work independently, raise your hand for the hard problems, and see them through to resolution without needing the spotlight.

  • You care about customers, about getting it right, and about the team around you. You're inspired by the idea of unreasonable hospitality: going beyond the expected to make people feel genuinely looked after.

  • You explain technical issues clearly, whether you're talking to an engineer or a non-technical stakeholder.

  • You're not afraid of the technical side. You don't need a CS or STEM degree: technical aptitude can come from your work, side projects or things you've built yourself. Hands-on experience with APIs, SQL or integrations helps, and you'll pick up the codebase with AI, the docs and the team behind you.

  • You use AI tools to move faster, with the judgment to know what to trust and what to double-check.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Backend Software Developer
description:
Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions).

  • Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation).

  • Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging.

  • Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden.

  • Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.


Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation. Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre. Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Customer Success Architect, you'll serve as a trusted strategic advisor and technical authority to some of GitLab's most complex and high-value Enterprise and Government customers across Japan. In this role, you will be driving and shaping how our largest customers adopt GitLab's intelligent DevSecOps platform to achieve their business goals and realise meaningful, long-term outcomes. You will be working closely with customers after the sale to turn pre-sales command plans into clear success plans, guide them through their customer journey, and drive adoption, utilization, and technical maturity. You will also be directly influencing renewal and expansion decisions through your post-sales engagements with executive-level decision makers in the account.

This is a individual-contributor role for someone who has already led pre or post sales customer engagements in large complex accounts across multiple industry domains to drive quantifiable business outcomes..The individual is comfortable operating with ambiguity, and can credibly advise VP- and C-level stakeholders on business transformation, application modernization, platform strategy, architecture, and organizational DevSecOps transformation. You'll also be shaping playbooks and best practices, and acting as an escalation point for the team's most technically or politically complex situations.

Reporting into the APJ Customer Success organization, you'll own a portfolio of GitLab's most strategic enterprise and Government accounts, act as the executive-level technical liaison for these accounts, and drive cross-functional resolution of their highest-priority issues — coordinating and, where needed, directing the efforts of Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and Support. You'll bring deep technical expertise in CI/CD, cloud platforms, multi-cloud, hybrid architecture and enterprise DevSecOps practices.You will use that expertise to shape customers' long-term platform strategy, apply best practices, configure GitLab for their environments and stay current with platform capabilities. In your first year, success will look like establishing yourself as the trusted senior advisor across a portfolio of flagship accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders, materially improving and increasing platform maturity, leading retention and renewal conversations, increasing customer satisfaction across your portfolio and contributing to the broader CSA team's technical standards and ways of working.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Turning pre-sales command plans into measurable customer success plans that align technical adoption with business outcomes
  • Leading and driving the technical strategy behind a large-scale DevSecOps platform consolidation for a regulated Enterprise account or Government, including guiding enterprise customers on GitLab best practices across CI/CD, DevSecOps, cloud architecture, TCO, applying compliance and architecture as well as business case presentations to customer executives
  • Owning end-to-end resolution of a critical, multi-team escalation for a flagship account — driving root cause analysis, coordinating Engineering/Product/Support, and personally briefing customer executives on remediation

What you’ll do

  • Owns a book of Enterprise and Government customers and drive adoption, retention, expansion, and overall satisfaction through ongoing strategic, business and technical engagement.
  • Serves as the senior post-sales strategic, business and technical advisor for a portfolio of GitLab's most complex, highest-value enterprise and Government accounts, shaping multi-year platform and DevSecOps strategy in partnership with customer executives, coordinating responses to questions, issues, and escalations across Support, Product Management, Sales, and Professional Services.
  • Translates ambiguous, high-stakes business outcomes into rigorous Customer Success Plans that are regularly reviewed with customer stakeholders. The Customer Success Plans contain clearly defined business outcome related goals, quantifiable benefits, realistic adoption milestones and remediation actions.
  • Prepares executive-ready reporting conducted on a regular basis with clear accountability for outcomes that demonstrate impact on adoption, retention, and expansion of GitLab products and services.
  • Provides deep technical guidance on enterprise-scale CI/CD architecture, DevSecOps maturity models, platform consolidation strategy, including advising on complex trade-offs (e.g., multi-cloud vs. hybrid, self-managed vs. GitLab Dedicated, etc).
  • Owns the full lifecycle of your account portfolio's adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes, with direct accountability for the commercial and technical health of flagship relationships.
  • Leads end-to-end resolution of critical, cross-functional account escalations, ensuring root causes are identified, follow-up actions are owned, holding internal teams accountable to timelines, driving the root cause analysis and personally managing executive communication and risk.
  • Leads end-to-end resolution of critical, cross-functional account escalations, ensuring root causes are identified, follow-up actions are owned, holding internal teams accountable to timelines, driving the driving root cause analysis and personally managing executive communication and risk.
  • Designs and delivers technical enablement programs at scale, identifying systemic maturity gaps across a portfolio and building the roadmap (not just individual sessions) that closes them.
  • Advises key customers stakeholders on cloud and platform architecture decisions with enterprise-wide impact, which includes multi-region deployment strategy, secrets management architecture and network/security topology for regulated environments.
  • Guides customers on GitLab platform best practices including Git workflows, branching strategies, CI/CD pipeline design, DevSecOps adoption patterns, and security scanning configuration.
  • Provides hands-on technical enablement and onboarding, including education on GitLab features, releases, and use cases, and identification of training and maturity opportunities aligned to customer goals.
  • Engages customers on cloud platform architecture decisions relevant to their GitLab deployment — including self-managed vs. GitLab Dedicated, Runner configuration and auto-scaling, secrets management, and network topology considerations.
  • Advises customers on DevSecOps consolidation value — articulating the TCO, compliance, and developer experience case for platform consolidation over fragmented toolchains.
  • Collaborates with Professional Services, Sales, and internal teams to identify expansion opportunities, recommend enablement interventions, and ensure a seamless customer journey from onboarding through renewal.

What you’ll bring

  • Must be a Japanese citizen based in Japan
  • Mandatory Japanese (native or professional level) and English language proficiency
  • Hands-on experience building or owning CI/CD pipelines end to end, including pipeline as code, multi-stage design, artifact management, and troubleshooting in real-world environments.
  • A career built across different direct customer facing engagement roles such as Technical Account Management, Technical Solution Sales, Pre-sales, Business Development, Consulting, Professional services across customers in different industry vertical domains like Government, Banking, Financial and Insurance Services, Manufacturing, Telecommunications, engagement with multiple technology and platform transition experience such as from on-premise deployments to Cloud, application modernization experience from monolith to microservices, from Waterfall to DevOps to DevSecOps and others to provide the depth and breadth of experience to advise customers on transformations and deployments that you've already seen play out elsewhere across your multiple customer engagements.
  • A long-standing demonstrated track record as the person other senior people call when an account is in genuine crisis or gained across a sustained career of Enterprise or Government account ownership
  • Credible judgment earned by personally owning the outcomes of dozens of complex enterprise customer account engagements over the course of a career, including situations with real commercial, technical, and reputational stakes
  • A consistent track record of being trusted by customer executives and internal leadership to operate with minimal oversight in ambiguous and high-pressure situations
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in DevSecOps practices, including shift-left security and integrating SAST, DAST, SCA, and container scanning into development workflows as well as architecting and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines at enterprise scale
  • Expert-level understanding of Git, merge request workflows and delivery lifecycles, having personally guided organizations through branching strategies such as trunk-based development and GitFlow, and modern software delivery lifecycles.
  • Demonstrated experience with infrastructure as code, GitOps, Cloud and on-premises environments with relevant experience that support GitLab deployments, including networking, identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, and deployment considerations for regulated or high-security environments
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with customers to turn business requirements into actionable success plans, with measurable goals and verifiable business outcomes that are suitable for executive-level quarterly reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive product adoption, dive deep into the accounts assigned and scale out the level of influence in the account.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and defend executive-level business cases (TCO, compliance, risk) that influence budget and platform strategy decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy in ambiguous, high-stakes situations with strong communication, stakeholder management, and organizational experience to manage a portfolio of enterprise and Government customers, balance multiple priorities, guide escalations, and coordinate effectively across customer teams and internal cross functional teams to resolve issues appropriately and in a timely manner.

About the team

The Customer Success Architect team is part of GitLab's Customer Experience organization. It supports strategic enterprise and Government accounts across the APJ region through hands-on technical guidance, consultative partnership, and practical problem solving.

We act as a reliable technical advisor and an important link between customers and the broader GitLab ecosystem. We bring platform, cloud, and DevSecOps depth to customer engagements and work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Support, and Professional Services to address questions, guide customers through technical choices, navigate escalations, and help them realize measurable value from GitLab.

Composed of team members working remotely across time zones, we operate asynchronously to support a focused set of strategic accounts across the region. It's a team well suited for people who enjoy solving complex customer challenges, building long-term partnerships, and helping enterprise organizations grow their maturity with GitLab in practical, measurable ways.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the worldâs leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Â

Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Â 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Purpose

Lead the establishment and ongoing oversight of the Pakistan entityâs independent Compliance function and Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing and Counter-Proliferation Financing (AML/CFT/CPF) framework.
