title: Content Reviewer - United States
description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
 
Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

title: Technical Architect
description:
Role Description

As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption.

You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria.
  • Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost.
  • Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria.
  • Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps.

Requirements

  • Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers.
  • AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations.
  • Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling.
  • Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure.
  • Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams.
  • Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in at least one of the following areas:

  • CASB/SSE/DLP platforms: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies.

  • Identity and access management: Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications.

  • Security ecosystems and integrations: Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customerâs broader security architecture.

  • Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read thisÂ blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

title: International Policy Intern
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Proxima Fusion is looking for an International Policy Intern to join the Partnerships and Public Affairs Team in Munich. You will work closely with the International Policy Team and contribute to Proxima's engagement with EU institutions, national governments and international organisations. Fusion is one of the fastest-moving industries in the world and European and international policy will shape how quickly it reaches the market. This internship offers direct exposure to that process and the opportunity to take on substantive responsibility from the start and be involved across a broad range of policy files, from EU funding and industrial policy to the regulatory frameworks for fusion.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Monitor EU policy, regulatory and financial developments, and analyse their impact on Proxima's business to anticipate opportunities and risks.

  • Research and analyse policy issues relevant to fusion energy at EU and international level.

  • Prepare briefings and background documents for meetings with EU policymakers, regulators, government representatives and other stakeholders.

  • Support the development of policy proposals, position papers and consultation responses for European institutions.

  • Support the coordination of government engagement across jurisdictions in Europe and globally, including bilateral meetings, delegation visits and international forums.

  • Support Proxima's participation in industry associations and policy events.

  • Work with Proxima's business and technical teams to keep policy and business priorities aligned, and share policy insights across the company.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Enrolled in or a recent graduate of a degree program in European Studies, Political Science, International Relations, Law, Public Policy, Economics, or a related discipline.

  • Solid understanding of European Union decision-making structures and legislative procedures.

  • Exceptional analytical, drafting, and synthesis capabilities, with a track record of distilling policy subjects into business-language.

  • Full professional proficiency in English. Additional languages preferred.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at "L1" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build, assemble and modify prototypes, experimental hardware, custom tooling and development rigs for engineering and special projects across the programme.

  • Turn engineering drawings, models, and sketches into practical hardware. Clarify missing requirements and agree the build approach with the responsible engineer before committing to uncertain or irreversible steps.

  • Fabricate and adapt components using fitting, cutting, drilling, soldering, bonding and assembly techniques within your competence. Coordinate specialist machining, welding or other work when needed.

  • Identify buildability issues early, including tolerance stacks, inaccessible fasteners, component fit and assembly sequence, and provide practical feedback to the design team.

  • Prepare and run development trials, including winding, joining, insulation and impregnation trials as assigned. Install instrumentation, commission rigs with engineers, take measurements and record what changed and what happened.

  • Investigate unexpected behaviour, propose practical fixes and work through build-test-modify iterations with engineers.

  • Organise the practical delivery of assigned projects: source small parts and consumables through agreed purchasing routes, arrange tools and build activities, and keep the workshop ready for use. Communicate progress, blockers and changing priorities to the lead technician.

  • Keep clear as-built records, annotated drawings, photographs, settings and trial observations so another technician can reproduce the work and understand each modification.

  • Transfer proven prototypes and methods to manufacturing or routine testing through initial work instructions, tooling, assembly sequences, training and technical handovers.

  • Work with engineers to identify hazards and establish the necessary risk assessments and controls before starting work on unproven hardware.

     

WHO YOU ARE

  • A technical apprenticeship or vocational qualification in mechanical, electrical, mechatronic or related engineering work, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Hands-on experience building, modifying and troubleshooting mechanical or electromechanical hardware in a workshop, laboratory, development or advanced manufacturing environment.

  • The ability to interpret engineering drawings, tolerances and 3D models, with working familiarity with geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) and practical measurement skills.

  • Confident hand-tool and workshop skills, sound fabrication and assembly judgement, and a willingness to develop unfamiliar techniques.

  • Resourcefulness with incomplete information: you investigate, ask useful questions, find suitable parts and propose a practical next step while keeping the engineering objective clear.

  • Sound judgement about technical uncertainty, safety and when a build or design change requires engineering review before proceeding.

  • The ability to organise work, adapt to agreed priority changes and document configurations and findings clearly.

  • Working English for technical discussions, drawings, instructions and build records.

Nice to have

  • Specialist fabrication skills such as manual or CNC machining, sheet-metal work, welding, brazing or additive manufacturing.

  • Experience creating or modifying simple parts and fixtures in CATIA, SolidWorks, Fusion 360 or similar CAD tools.

  • Experience with instrumentation, sensors, data acquisition, electrical wiring, vacuum, cryogenics or superconducting hardware.

  • Experience with composites, resins, vacuum bagging, insulation or impregnation.

  • Experience taking first-of-a-kind hardware or a prototype process through to repeatable manufacturing and technical handover.

  • German language skills.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

title: Manufacturing Technician
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Set up, operate and change over the HTS cable line and plate assembly stations. Deliver routine production alongside complex, first-article and non-standard builds.

  • Carry out precision assembly, fitting, fabrication and approved rework using drawings, work instructions and practical judgement.

  • Troubleshoot process, assembly and quality problems, including handling issues, setup errors, dimensional variation and inconsistent output. Contain affected work, investigate the cause and help implement a verified correction.

  • Resolve unfamiliar or undocumented scenarios within agreed safety, quality and change-control limits. Develop and document practical solutions, and obtain engineering or quality approval before proceeding outside your authority.

  • Verify setups and initial output, and inspect assemblies against released acceptance criteria at assigned in-process and final checks. Raise non-conformances and refer deviations or product-disposition decisions to the authorised owner.

  • Work with equipment technicians on machine faults; provide design and manufacturing engineers clear measurements and feedback on buildability, tooling, and process performance.

  • Run first-article builds and process trials with manufacturing engineering, and help prove tooling, fixtures and equipment ready for production.

  • Write, redline and improve work instructions and standard operating procedures using build experience. Route changes through review and release, and help improve cycle time, yield and repeatability.

  • Maintain complete build records, material traceability, deviation records and clear handovers.

     

WHO YOU ARE

  • Substantial hands-on experience building complex, high-precision assemblies, with capability beyond routine machine operation.

  • A technical apprenticeship or vocational qualification in a relevant discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Confidence interpreting engineering drawings, assembly requirements and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), and using measuring equipment to verify work.

  • Proven practical troubleshooting skills, including experience investigating unfamiliar problems and distinguishing symptoms from underlying causes.

  • Experience setting up equipment, using fixtures and handling sensitive components or materials with consistent workmanship.

  • The judgement to work with incomplete instructions while recognising when to proceed, stop or escalate, supported by a practical understanding of traceability, non-conformance and change control.

  • The ability to write instructions others can follow, explain technical problems clearly and train or support less-experienced technicians.

  • Working English for drawings, procedures, technical discussions and production records.

Nice to have

  • Experience manufacturing cables, coils, superconducting magnets or other high-reliability assemblies involving delicate materials or controlled handling.

  • Experience with winding, insulation, impregnation, soldering, brazing, precision bonding or reel-to-reel processing.

  • Experience introducing new products or processes, supporting pilot builds or transferring development work into production.

  • Familiarity with structured problem solving, such as Lean/Six Sigma improvement methods.

  • A Techniker or Meister qualification.

  • German language skills.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

title: AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
description:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role

As an AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri.

  • You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

  • No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

  • We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

  • Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

  • Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates.
    The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

  • Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

  • We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

Requirements

  • At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before.

  • As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor.

  • Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful:

    • Test Driven Development (TDD)

    • Trunk based development

    • Continuous integration

    • Domain Driven Design

Nice-to-haves

  • Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase.

  • Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes.

  • We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.

What we offer

  • Become part of an AI revolution!

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub

  • Mental health support through nilo.health

  • Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

  • Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

  • Budget for additional technical equipment

  • Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model

  • JobRad® Bike Lease

Note: We welcome applicants at every stage of their career. Your drive and willingness to learn are far more important to us than strict experience requirements.

title: Spacecraft Thermal Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

We are seeking a Spacecraft Thermal Engineer to join our Thermal Control System team. You will contribute to the preparation, execution and analysis of thermal verification activities, including Thermal Vacuum (TVAC) and Thermal Balance testing, and support spacecraft assembly, integration and test. Alongside these activities, you will take technical ownership of assigned thermal control products, following their development, supplier activities, qualification and delivery for integration.

You will work closely with AIT, suppliers, external test facilities and other subsystem teams. You will be part of the TCS & ECLSS Team and report to the Principal Thermal Control System Engineer.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Ownership and Supplier Follow-up

  • Take technical ownership of assigned thermal control products, from requirements and interface definition through qualification and delivery for integration, with guidance from senior engineers.

  • Act as the day-to-day technical interface with suppliers, following design, manufacturing, testing and delivery activities.

  • Review supplier deliverables, including design justifications, test procedures and reports, against agreed requirements.

  • Maintain product requirements, interfaces, configuration information and technical documentation.

  • Prepare product review documentation and coordinate the closure of review actions.

  • Track product maturity, technical risks and delivery milestones, escalating issues affecting performance, cost or schedule.

  • Coordinate with AIT to ensure hardware is delivered with the appropriate configuration, documentation and verification status.

Thermal Testing and Verification

  • Contribute to the definition of thermal test objectives, configurations and success criteria.

  • Prepare test plans, procedures and instrumentation requirements in coordination with AIT and test facilities.

  • Support spacecraft-level TVAC and Thermal Balance campaigns, and coordinate testing activities for assigned thermal control products.

  • Contribute to test readiness reviews, test execution and anomaly investigations.

  • Prepare test reports and verification evidence, maintaining traceability to applicable requirements.

  • Track verification activities and follow technical actions through to closure within your assigned scope.

Flight Model Integration and AIT Support

  • Work alongside AIT teams during the installation, integration and verification of thermal control hardware.

  • Contribute to integration procedures, thermal instrumentation layouts and test configurations.

  • Support functional testing, troubleshooting and spacecraft system check-outs.

  • Support leak testing and fluid loop commissioning, as applicable to assigned activities.

  • Investigate integration issues with the relevant engineering, supplier and quality teams.

Thermal Test Data Analysis

  • Support pre-test thermal predictions in collaboration with thermal analysts.

  • Process and analyse test data to assess hardware and system performance against requirements.

  • Contribute to thermal model correlation and the investigation of discrepancies between predictions and test results.

  • Recommend design or test improvements and capture lessons learned.

What We Would Love to See from You

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Thermodynamics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in spacecraft thermal engineering, including thermal hardware development, integration or testing.

  • Hands-on experience contributing to thermal test campaigns, such as TVAC or Thermal Balance testing.

  • Good understanding of spacecraft thermal control hardware, such as MLI, temperature sensors, heaters and fluid loop components.

  • Familiarity with spacecraft qualification and acceptance processes, requirements traceability and verification documentation.

  • Experience contributing to hardware development or supplier follow-up, including reviewing technical documentation and tracking actions.

  • Familiarity with thermal instrumentation, data acquisition systems and test facility interfaces.

  • Experience processing and analysing engineering data using Python, MATLAB or equivalent tools.

  • Familiarity with applicable space engineering standards, including ECSS and NASA ones.

  • Fluent in English. German, French and Italian are an asset.

Skills and Behaviors:

  • Ownership mindset, with the ability to drive assigned activities to completion and seek support when needed.

  • Strong analytical and practical problem-solving skills.

  • Clear written and verbal communication.

  • Ability to organise priorities, maintain technical documentation and follow actions through to closure.

  • Collaborative approach to working across engineering disciplines, suppliers and AIT teams.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to getting the job done.

  • Behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Vision, Competence, Integrity and Passion.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets.

What You'll Do

- Run and document campaign kick-offs, check-ins and retros, follow up on action items, support vendor and freelancer coordination, and propose process improvements that make delivery faster and more scalable.

- Clear, structured communication in English, comfortable chasing inputs and keeping teams aligned.

- A detail-oriented approach to documentation, file management and process, with a habit of spotting gaps and fixing them.

- Interest in marketing, campaign delivery or project coordination, ideally backed by coursework, internships or hands-on project experience.

- Familiarity with project management or DAM tools such as Jira (nice to have).

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, no endless unpaid crunch

Based in our Paris office, you will take ownership of the Invoice-to-Cash cycle for our Public Sector and complex accounts in France.

  • Rigor & Organization: With each public sector client having its own rules, you are methodical, autonomous, and highly detail-oriented.

  • Technical Skills: You have strong Excel skills and feel comfortable with financial tools (experience with JIRA or cash collection tools is a plus).

4 weeks, Monday - Friday

A note on location

This is a remote role, but candidates must be located in the US in Eastern timezone. This is a hard requirement driven by contractual data access obligations with our enterprise customers, not a preference - we are not able to make exceptions.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Platform and integration investigation. Diagnose configuration questions, known error patterns, API and webhook issues, and account-specific behavior across the Nash platform.

  • Escalation quality. When an issue needs Engineering or Enterprise Operations, you own the handoff — clear reproduction steps, investigation performed, impact assessment, and severity. Escalations from this team are expected to be actionable on arrival.

  • Incident coordination. Serve as the active shift team for P1 incidents — coordinating communication, engaging Engineering immediately, and keeping customers and internal stakeholders informed through resolution.

  • Proactive monitoring. Watch Datadog dashboards, alerts, and logs for anomalies and emerging risks. Surface issues before they become customer-impacting where possible.

  • Knowledge base contribution. Document resolution patterns for novel issues so the next occurrence becomes a known pattern. Your work directly reduces future escalation volume.

  • Overflow support. Act as overflow for Delivery Support during peak windows when issues exceed their scope.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2 - 5+ years in Technical Support, Support Engineering, or a related technical role in a SaaS environment

  • Hands-on experience investigating complex platform issues - not just routing tickets, but actually diagnosing what is happening

  • Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and integration troubleshooting in a production environment

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, or similar)

  • Clear, calm written communication — especially during incidents or when customers are frustrated

  • Judgment about when to investigate further versus escalate, and the discipline to document thoroughly either way

  • Located in US, eastern timezone (remote)

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience supporting logistics, marketplace, or high-volume transactional platforms

  • Prior incident response or post-mortem participation

  • Experience contributing to knowledge bases or support documentation that actually gets used

  • Familiarity with ticketing platforms like Pylon, Zendesk, or similar

More about Nash

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

What You’ll Love About Us

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

title: Operations Analyst
description:
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

We are looking for a sharp, analytical, and highly proactive Operations Analyst to join our Service Delivery Operations team. This role operates at the intersection of workforce planning, staffing, capacity management, delivery operations, and operational intelligence.

The Operations Analyst will help translate business demand into workforce and operational decisions by analyzing capacity, skills, utilization, pipeline, delivery needs, and operational risk. You will partner across Delivery, Sales, Talent, Finance, and other business functions to identify constraints, surface risks, recommend actions, and drive decisions through execution.

This role will increasingly focus on exception management, analytical judgment, workforce optimization, and decision support rather than transactional coordination and manual reporting.

The ideal candidate is a strong critical thinker who can operate independently in ambiguity, connect information across multiple parts of the business, challenge assumptions when appropriate, and turn data into clear recommendations and action.

Your Assignment

  • Manage day-to-day operational activities for an assigned area of the business, developing a strong understanding of its demand, workforce, capacity, staffing needs, delivery risks, and business priorities.
  • Analyze demand, capacity, skills, utilization, availability, pipeline, bench, and delivery requirements to identify risks, constraints, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Manage staffing and resource-allocation workflows from demand identification through assignment, applying established governance while balancing customer needs, skills alignment, utilization, and enterprise capacity.
  • Partner with Delivery, Sales, Talent, Finance, and other stakeholders to translate business demand into workforce plans and provide data-driven staffing, capacity, and hiring recommendations.
  • Identify and proactively escalate capacity constraints, staffing conflicts, bench risk, skills gaps, forecast variance, and other operational exceptions with recommended actions—not simply status updates.
  • Develop and maintain workforce and operational intelligence that enables leadership to understand trends, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions required across the business.
  • Use AI, automation, analytics, and operational systems to reduce manual work, improve data quality, identify patterns, and increase the speed and quality of operational decision-making.
  • Identify, design, and implement process and workflow improvements that increase scalability, accountability, and operational effectiveness.
  • Maintain strong operational governance and data integrity across staffing, capacity, forecasting, project lifecycle, and delivery systems.
  • Support end-to-end delivery operations, including Sales-to-Delivery transitions, resource planning, staffing assignments, project setup and closeout, and engagement data integrity.
  • Own recurring capacity, staffing, and forecasting reviews for assigned business areas, ensuring leadership receives decision-ready insights rather than transactional reporting.
  • Work independently within established operating frameworks, proactively resolving issues and escalating exceptions that require broader business tradeoffs or leadership decisions.

Your Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 3–5 years of experience in an operations, resource management, workforce planning, staffing, or capacity planning role within a consulting or professional services environment.
  • Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze business problems, identify root causes, evaluate tradeoffs, and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting utilization, capacity, availability, demand, pipeline, forecasting, and other operational metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, operate effectively in ambiguity, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and proactively drive work through resolution.
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills, with the ability to connect information across functions and translate data and findings into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders and leadership.
  • Experience with professional services and resource management systems such as Certinia PSA and Salesforce, with the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with AWS, cloud consulting, or technology professional services environments.
  • Familiarity with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI.
  • Exposure to GenAI and automation tools used to improve operational workflows, analysis, or decision-making.
  • Advanced proficiency with Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel.

Benefits

  • Pay in USD
  • 100% remote work
  • Generous holidays and flexible PTO
  • Competitive phantom equity
  • Paid for exams and certifications
  • Peer bonus awards
  • State of the art laptop and tools
  • Equipment & Office Stipend
  • Individual professional development plan
  • Annual stipend for Learning and Development
  • Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture

NOTE: This position requires current legal authorization to work in the country where this position is located. Caylent is not able to sponsor visa or work permit applications at this time.

At Caylent, we are committed to fair, transparent, and inclusive hiring practices. As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools or automated systems to assist with the screening and evaluation of applications to help match candidate qualifications with job requirements.
These tools are designed to support — not replace — human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by our trained recruitment professionals.
If an AI or automated tool is used during your application process, it will only be in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, and your information will be handled in a secure and confidential manner.
If you have any questions, please contact talent@caylent.com

Caylent is a place where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at Caylent.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at hr@caylent.com.

title: Strategic Account Executive, Financial Services - Brazil
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Strategic Account Executive, you’ll help expand GitLab’s presence across Financial Services in Brazil by building trusted relationships with senior leaders at large organizations and guiding them through complex platform decisions. You’ll use a consultative sales approach to connect customer business needs with our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, helping teams improve developer productivity, reduce security and compliance risk, and move software delivery forward with more confidence. In this role, you’ll support strategic accounts across the full customer journey, from early conversations through adoption, while helping us position GitLab as a leading DevSecOps partner in the Brazilian market.

You’ll work across pre-sales, post-sales, partner, marketing, and support teams, and we’ll rely on you to bring strong account leadership, customer outcomes, and clear communication in English and Portuguese. Over your first year, your impact will come from building account plans for large organizations, developing new opportunities, and helping customers successfully adopt GitLab in ways that align to their business goals.

What you’ll do

  • Lead strategic account activity for prospects and customers across Financial Services in Brazil, providing direction throughout pre-sales and post-sales engagements.

  • Develop opportunities within Financial Services accounts through prospecting, relationship building, and a consultative understanding of customer business needs.

  • Create account plans and customer proposals that clearly connect GitLab capabilities to organizational priorities and transformation goals.

  • Coordinate with pre-sales, post-sales, and support teams to support successful product rollout and customer adoption.

  • Generate qualified pipeline in partnership with strategic channel partners and support new customer development efforts.

  • Contribute customer feedback and product ideas to GitLab’s public issue tracker to represent the voice of the customer.

  • Prepare activity and forecast reports, and help analyze wins and losses to improve future sales execution.

  • Collaborate with marketing, account teams, product managers, and technical teams to share lessons learned and communicate customer needs clearly.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years experience selling into large organizations and navigating complex Financial Services sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

  • Ability to build and manage executive-level customer relationships with a high degree of ownership and follow-through.

  • Skill in consultative selling, including shaping proposals, presentations, and formal quotes around customer business needs.

  • Strength in negotiation, presentation, and closing conversations in a clear and effective way.

  • Comfort working independently on complex projects while coordinating with cross-functional teams.

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese for customer-facing and internal communication.

  • Familiarity with GitLab or related tools, including Git, software development tools, application lifecycle management, or security and application security tools.

  • Alignment with GitLab’s values, with openness to transferable experience from adjacent technical or software environments.

About the team

The team focuses on growing GitLab’s Financial Services business in Brazil by helping organizations adopt a single platform for software delivery, security, and collaboration. This role works closely with cross-functional partners across sales, solutions, support, marketing, and product, and contributes to an asynchronous, distributed way of working that values transparency, accountability, and shared customer insight. The team’s work sits at the intersection of strategic growth and customer transformation, with a focus on helping Financial Services organizations evaluate, adopt, and expand their use of GitLab across complex environments.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

title: Medical Oncologist
description:
Role type: Contractor

Location: Remote, United States only

Commitment: Part-time, project-based

Compensation: $160–$180 USD per hour

About the role

micro1 is looking for experienced Medical Oncologists to support a customer project focused on improving AI-generated clinical documentation.

In this role, you'll use your clinical expertise to evaluate AI-generated transcripts and medical notes from outpatient oncology encounters. Your feedback will help improve the accuracy, completeness, and clinical relevance of AI-assisted documentation.

What you'll do

  1. Review AI-generated transcripts of outpatient oncology visits for clinical accuracy, completeness, and clarity.
  2. Evaluate clinical documentation, including History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment and Plans (A&Ps).
  3. Identify inaccuracies or missing details related to cancer diagnoses, staging, treatment plans, and laboratory or imaging findings.
  4. Assess documentation of systemic cancer therapies, including chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapies, and supportive care.
  5. Review how clinical notes capture treatment responses, adverse effects, disease progression, and follow-up care.
  6. Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve AI-generated clinical notes and EHR documentation.

Required qualifications

  1. MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree, with board certification or eligibility in Medical Oncology.
  2. At least 2 years of recent outpatient medical oncology experience following fellowship.
  3. Strong clinical experience diagnosing and managing solid tumors, including treatment planning and longitudinal patient care.
  4. Proven ability to independently document HPIs, interval histories, and Assessment and Plans.
  5. Solid understanding of systemic cancer therapies, treatment-related toxicities, supportive care, and interpretation of laboratory and imaging results.
  6. Strong written communication skills and attention to clinical detail.
  7. Based in the United States.

Preferred qualifications

  1. Experience managing a broad range of solid tumors and complex oncology cases.
  2. Familiarity with AI scribe technology, EHR documentation templates, medical chart review, or clinical annotation projects.

Application process

Candidates will complete an AI interview to assess their relevant clinical expertise and experience.

About micro1

micro1 is a data lab that connects professionals with opportunities to apply their expertise to customer projects. We work with specialists across fields such as engineering, finance, healthcare, and law to support AI labs and enterprises. Through our extended network, contributors bring their knowledge and judgment to projects with their own scope, requirements, and engagement terms.

title: Hematologist
description:
Hematologist

Role type: Contractor

Location: Remote, United States only

Commitment: Part-time, project-based

Compensation: $160–$180 USD per hour

About the role

micro1 is looking for experienced Hematologists to support a customer project focused on improving AI-generated clinical documentation.

In this role, you'll use your clinical expertise to evaluate AI-generated transcripts and medical notes from outpatient hematology encounters. Your feedback will help improve the accuracy, completeness, and clinical relevance of AI-assisted documentation.

What you'll do

  1. Review AI-generated transcripts of outpatient hematology visits for clinical accuracy, completeness, and clarity.
  2. Evaluate clinical documentation, including History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment and Plans (A&Ps).
  3. Identify inaccuracies or missing details related to hematologic diagnoses, treatment plans, medication management, and laboratory findings.
  4. Assess documentation of blood disorders, including anemia, bleeding and clotting disorders, and hematologic malignancies.
  5. Review how clinical notes capture treatment responses, adverse effects, transfusion requirements, and follow-up care.
  6. Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve AI-generated clinical notes and EHR documentation.

Required qualifications

  1. MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree, with board certification or eligibility in Hematology.
  2. At least 2 years of recent outpatient hematology experience following fellowship.
  3. Strong clinical experience diagnosing and managing hematologic disorders, including treatment planning and longitudinal patient care.
  4. Proven ability to independently document HPIs, interval histories, and Assessment and Plans.
  5. Solid understanding of hematologic treatments, transfusion practices, anticoagulation management, and laboratory interpretation.
  6. Strong written communication skills and attention to clinical detail.
  7. Based in the United States.

Preferred qualifications

  1. Experience treating both malignant and non-malignant hematologic conditions, such as leukemia, lymphoma, anemia, sickle cell disease, and coagulation disorders.
  2. Familiarity with AI scribe technology, EHR documentation templates, medical chart review, or clinical annotation projects.

Application process

Candidates will complete an AI interview to assess their relevant clinical expertise and experience.

About micro1

micro1 is a data lab that connects professionals with opportunities to apply their expertise to customer projects. We work with specialists across fields such as engineering, finance, healthcare, and law to support AI labs and enterprises. Through our extended network, contributors bring their knowledge and judgment to projects with their own scope, requirements, and engagement terms.

title: Hematology/Oncology Physician
description:
Role Title: Hematology/Oncology Physician

Role Type: Contractor

Location: United States, Remote

micro1 is engaging Hematology/Oncology Physicians to contribute expertise and insights to a forward-thinking customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. This is an exciting opportunity for professionals who have recently practiced outpatient hematology/oncology after fellowship, and who are passionate about accurate clinical communication and documentation.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and annotate AI Generated transcripts of outpatient hematology/oncology clinic conversations for accuracy, clinical completeness, and clarity.
  2. Assess AI Generated documentation sections such as History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment & Plans (A&Ps), providing input on appropriate information inclusion.
  3. Identify and comment on nuances of chemotherapy cycles, treatment toxicities, laboratory discussions, and decision-making processes in clinical documentation.
  4. Provide feedback on how well AI Generated transcripts reflect real-world clinical reasoning and patient interactions, especially during follow-up visits.
  5. Contribute to the evaluation and improvement of AI scribe outputs or EHR note templates, as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. MD, DO, or equivalent with board certification or eligibility in Hematology and/or Oncology.
  2. At least 2 years of recent outpatient clinical experience post-fellowship, focusing on patient follow-up visits, chemotherapy management, and longitudinal care.
  3. Demonstrated proficiency in independently writing HPIs, interval histories, and A&Ps for outpatient oncology or hematology care.
  4. Comprehensive understanding of chemotherapy treatment cycles, side effect management, and lab result interpretation in an outpatient setting.
  5. Experience with ambient AI scribe solutions, EHR note templates, annotation projects, or medical chart review (preferred but not required).
  6. Familiarity with best practices in outpatient oncology workflow and a track record of clear, patient-centered clinical interactions.

title: Video Creator (100% remote)
location: USA, Canada, Ireland and UK ONLY
description:
Make videos about brands you love and get paid, no followers required!

We're Marker Video, and we'd love for you to join our platform!👋

Sign up (it's free) and create videos about brands you love across beauty, food & drink, lifestyle, fitness, and travel.

Brands actively buying videos from their real customers (that's you) on Marker include: HelloFresh, Ollie Pets, Camile Thai, Spencer's Gifts and lots more. 

Create videos in your own tone of voice and style with no briefs or scripts from the brands. Authenticity and videos filled with your unique perspective are what brands need and want.

Videos can be reviews, tutorials, first impressions, unboxing videos, vlogs, etc. Just keep them to 30 seconds or less! 

Once your video has been uploaded to Marker, we'll notify the brand, and they can buy and use it for their marketing. 

You’ll get paid $100 for each video you successfully sell, and you can submit as many videos as you like (the more you upload, the more you can earn). 

To sign up, ensure you are: 

  • Based only in the USA, Canada, Ireland or the UK (although you submit videos remotely, we are only Stripe-enabled in select territories, so if you sign up from elsewhere, we won't be able to verify or pay you).

  • Comfortable in front of the camera

  • Fluent in spoken & written English

  • A strong, confident storyteller 

  • Competent in recording, editing and uploading videos for socials 

  • Seriously interested in TikTok & Instagram

  • Passionate about brands and products, and the content on their social channels 

Note that this is not a full-time role. Upload videos as and when you choose, and you’ll be paid for each video you sell on Marker.

Please register via the provided link ONLY; note that any applicants who email us to apply will not be registered on our system.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 
Team Marker
